body.statement: The array in \(\mathrm{def:j2s2-instance}\), with common interval \([0,2]\) and \(D=2\), belongs to \(\mathcal M\): its pre laws meet the smooth-density bounds, its same weight spans both pre and post no-intervention quantiles, its observed post laws have at most two atoms, and its pooled Gram satisfies the maintained bound for \(0<\lambda\leq1/375\). For every \(\kappa\in(0,\infty)\), \(G,R>0\), and \(\varepsilon>0\), the compactification and interval algorithm of \(\mathrm{thm:oracle-common-cutoff}\) terminates for the certified family \(\{\mathfrak E_{2,2}(h_f,h_c):0\leq h_f\leq2G/\lambda,\ 0\leq h_c\leq2R\}\). It returns an interval of width at most \(\varepsilon\) containing \(\sup_{0\leq h_f\leq2G/\lambda,\,0\leq h_c\leq2R}Q_{0.95}\{(1+\kappa)^{-1}A_t(V_{(\infty,h_f)})+\kappa(1+\kappa)^{-1}\Psi_t(h_c,Z)\}\), and every coverage probability used in the optimization is enclosed between explicit lower and upper Gaussian-cell sums differing by at most \(\varepsilon\). As \(R\to\infty\) and then \(\kappa\to\infty\), the face term vanishes and the certified family reduces to the one-donor Bernoulli problem, where \(\widehat w_\ell=w_\ell=1\) and every weight and cross term is zero, reproducing \(1.913<c_B^*\leq1.914\).
body.justification: This finite face-plus-collision instance is the early kill test for the claimed certification machinery and links it to the independently checked Bernoulli bracket.
body.gap: No direct DSC inference paper supplies a certified probability enclosure for a simultaneous local simplex face and atomic knot collision.
body.consumer: It gives a reproducible validation case before calibration of the intervention-versus-no-intervention QTE is applied to higher-dimensional mosquito-abundance support patterns.
